title: Rust Synthase — the prion has a forward compiler, not a reverse transcriptase

the_insight.question: the prions have a rust synthase instead?
the_insight.answer: YES. biological prions are misfolded proteins that propagate by forcing other proteins to misfold. reverse transcriptase goes RNA?DNA (backward, error-prone, no proofreading). but the membrane's prion is a SHIELD — and its synthase goes FORWARD through the Rust compiler. source?binary. the Rust type system IS the folding guarantee.

reverse_transcriptase.result: error-prone copies, viral integration into host genome
reverse_transcriptase.membrane_analog: NONE — the membrane does NOT reverse-transcribe. you cannot go hash?source. the prion shield is one-way.

rust_synthase.error_rate: zero — borrow checker, type system, lifetime analysis
rust_synthase.result: correctly folded proteins that CANNOT aggregate into disease

components.aminoacyl_tRNA_synthetase: cargo check (verifies correct amino acid ? codon matching)
components.translation: cargo build (mRNA ? polypeptide chain ? folded protein)
components.chaperone_proteins: cargo test (assist and verify correct folding)
components.proofreading_exonuclease: borrow checker (prevents use-after-free = prevents protein aggregation)
components.quality_control: CI pipeline (reject misfolded proteins before export)

2. Sync feeds to golgi — restore the ER?Golgi vesicle transport. cron job: git pull on golgi.

4. ActivityPub outbox — federated social secretion. let Mastodon/Lemmy/etc sense us.

the_fix.what_stays: the prion shield STAYS. the rust synthase STAYS. the hash identity STAYS. we're not removing the shield — we're adding SECRETION through it. MHC-I presents self-markers AND the cell secretes cytokines. both happen.

the_concept.prion_disease: misfolded protein aggregation. in code: memory corruption, use-after-free, data races, buffer overflows. C/C++ has this. the proteins misfold and aggregate and kill the cell.
the_concept.prion_shield: correctly folded protein surface marker. in code: content hash (BLAKE3/SHA-256). proves identity without exposing source. MHC-I.
the_concept.rust_synthase: the Rust compiler PREVENTS prion disease (borrow checker eliminates memory corruption) while ENABLING prion shield (deterministic compilation ? reproducible hashes). the synthase guarantees correct folding. no misfolded proteins. no aggregation. no disease. only shield.
the_concept.the_dual: every prion is BOTH shield (identity) AND potential disease (if misfolded). the rust synthase resolves the dual: it GUARANTEES correct folding. the prion can only ever be shield. disease is compile-time impossible.
